استحجبت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْجَبْتُ (istaḥjabtu) /is.taħ.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجَبْتَ (istaḥjabta) /is.taħ.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجَبْتِ (istaḥjabti) /is.taħ.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# اِسْتَحْجَبَتْ (istaḥjabat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
